name: kaizen
description: Continuous improvement of the collaboration with agents (kaizen): a playbook for the life of a project, a requirements interview along a demand and requirements form, a stakeholder walk-through, a hallway test by a fresh sub-agent (by behaviour, by eye, as a diagnosis, on documents and instruction files), a field test with a person in real use, and a debrief with cited moments, coaching for the person, a kaizen ledger and transcript tools; with skills to update a project to a new plugin version and to keep it in step with its upstream.
